changes.name: UpgradeSigns
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local old=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeSigns")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="UpgradeSigns"
folder.Parent=world

local function makeSign(number,x)
 local post=Instance.new("Part")
 post.Name="Upgrade"..number.."Post"
 post.Size=Vector3.new(1,5,1)
 post.Position=Vector3.new(x,22.5,-16)
 post.Anchored=true
 post.Color=Color3.fromRGB(93,66,43)
 post.Material=Enum.Material.Wood
 post.Parent=folder

 local board=Instance.new("Part")
 board.Name="Upgrade"..number.."Sign"
 board.Size=Vector3.new(9,5,.7)
 board.Position=Vector3.new(x,26,-16)
 board.Anchored=true
 board.Color=Color3.fromRGB(48,54,66)
 board.Material=Enum.Material.Slate
 board.Parent=folder

 local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
 gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Back
 gui.Parent=board

 local text=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 text.BackgroundTransparency=1
 text.Text="UPGRADE "..number.."\nCOMING SOON"
 text.TextWrapped=true
 text.TextScaled=true
 text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,120)
 text.Parent=gui
end

makeSign(1,-11)
makeSign(2,0)
makeSign(3,11)

print("Three upgrade signs loaded")
